title: What Is a Wave on the Ocean?
hook: Energy travels. Water mostly goes up and down.
narration: Energy travels. Water mostly goes up and down.
Wind piles energy into the surface.
When the wave hits a beach, the bottom drags and it breaks.
Surf is delivered energy, not a wall of water from far away.
